items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: How long did you take lessons from Jim Humphrey? About five years.

ctx.x: I had no idea. Well, let's see now. How long did you take lessons from Jim Humphrey? About five years. About five years. You must start at your own, I guess. Four years, I taught.
My daughter, I was young, I was 19. About 19, 1918.
